Bengaluru Metro Green Line Services Delayed Due to Signalling Issue

Services on Bengaluru's Namma Metro Green Line experienced significant delays during the morning peak hours on a particular day due to a signalling problem. The disruption affected train movements along the entire 33.46-km route, which spans from Madavara to Silk Institute. This incident highlights ongoing challenges with the metro's operational reliability.
